description: Hides older large tool outputs from model requests in cache-friendly batches, keeping each call and a recall tool for the full text

keep_recent.title: Recent outputs kept
keep_recent.description: Newest tool outputs always sent in full (at least 1)

min_bytes.title: Minimum size
min_bytes.description: Outputs smaller than this many bytes are never hidden

batch_bytes.title: Batch size
batch_bytes.description: Bytes of hideable outputs to collect before hiding them at once; 0 hides each as soon as it is old enough
